steps.description:
With some creativity, plain looking characters can be used to form wonderful graphics, which we commonly call ASCII art.
     


Let's do a simple ASCII art. Make your robot display the following emoticons on the LCD. Let it stay there forever.

Instead of stationary display, we can create animation by timing a display sequence. Animation is very useful in making a project interesting.
The Forever loop enables you repeat your codes infinitely. Of course, you can still terminate the program with the Stop button in your portal.
    

Display the following emoticon sequence:
  1. Its eyes stay open for 2 seconds, then blink for 0.5 second.


  2. Make it repeat forever using the Forever Loop.

Form an animation sequence as follows:

  1. Display "..." for 0.2 second.
  2. Display "o.." for 0.2 second.
  3. Display ".o." for 0.2 second.
  4. Display "..o" for 0.2 second.
  5. Repeat the sequence forever.

Now that you have learnt about sequences and patterns, let's test your ability to identify them.

Watch the clip below and create the code. The sequence should repeat forever.


1. Use a duration of 0.2 second with 7 LCD blocks.

2. Look at the animation of one column at a time

Create a flowchart of the previous step (load the snippet of your previouse step's codes on a separate browser tab).

Refer to the notes on flowchart: https://tinyurl.com/TheLabHatFlowchart


Note: Flowcharts will be saved in snippets under "Diagrams and Flowcharts". If you want to continue editing a previously saved flowchart, load it from the snippets.
